notes.title: No Body Home: Steam beta keys!
notes.content:
No Body Home is a 2-player co-op platformer about two ghosts searching for cake in a house that’s haunted with humans.

It can be played local multiplayer OR online through Steam Remote Play (both players each need their own beta key).

https://youtu.be/3EwUMmXOutI

If you’re interested, [url=https://www.discord.gg/thesheepsmeow]join the official Discord[/url] and post in the [b]#steam-key-sign-up[/b] channel to be DM’d a Steam beta key. 

Thanks!
